ei.title: Algorithms as Architects of Our Digital Choices
ei.subject: 9월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Algorithms as Architects of Our Digital Choices

fullPassage: The concept of “choice architecture,” popularized in behavioral economics, highlights how the design of the environment in which choices are made can significantly influence the decisions people make. Algorithms are, in essence, sophisticated architects of our digital environments. By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths. While nudges can be used for beneficial purposes, such as encouraging healthier habits, they also carry the potential for manipulation, particularly when the underlying objectives of the architects are not aligned with the well-being or autonomy of the individual. The question then becomes: how can we cultivate and protect our human agency in an increasingly algorithmic world? It requires a conscious effort to maintain critical engagement with the technologies we use. It means actively seeking out diverse perspectives, following algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain. It involves cultivating a healthy skepticism towards the seemingly objective outputs of algorithms and remembering that these systems are designed by humans with specific goals, and that their data is a reflection of past realities, not necessarily a prescription for future flourishing.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ① use → used — 'nudges can be ___ for beneficial purposes'에서 넛지는 '사용되는' 대상이라 수동 관계예요. 조동사 can 뒤에 'be + 과거분사'가 오면 수동태가 되므로 used가 맞아요. use는 원형이라 틀려요 ←정답

❌ ② agency — '인간의 주체성'이라는 명사 자리라 agency가 맞아요

❌ ③ conscious — 명사 effort를 꾸미는 형용사 자리라 conscious가 맞아요

❌ ④ perspectives — diverse를 뒤에서 받는 명사 자리라 perspectives가 맞아요
det.tip: can be + 과거분사(used) = ~될 수 있다(조동사+수동태)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답 ② our digital environments(우리의 디지털 환경): 알고리즘이 설계하는 대상

❌ ③ a peaceful retirement(평화로운 은퇴) — 문맥과 무관해요

❌ ④ an ancient tradition(고대 전통) — 문맥과 무관해요

det.korean: 정답 ③ — 넛지는 유익한 목적으로도 쓰일 수 있다고 했으므로 불일치

questions.passage: The concept of “choice architecture,” popularized in behavioral economics, highlights how the design of the environment in which choices are made can significantly influence the decisions people make. Algorithms are, in essence, sophisticated architects of our digital environments. By curating what we see, what we are recommended, and what options are presented to us, they subtly, and sometimes not so subtly, nudge us towards particular paths. While nudges can be used for beneficial purposes, such as encouraging healthier habits, they also carry the potential for manipulation, particularly when the underlying objectives of the architects are not aligned with the well-being or autonomy of the individual. The question then becomes: how can we cultivate and protect our human agency in an increasingly algorithmic world? It requires a conscious effort to maintain critical engagement with the technologies we use. It means actively seeking out diverse perspectives, following algorithmic recommendations, and making deliberate choices that go against the predicted grain. It involves cultivating a healthy skepticism towards the seemingly objective outputs of algorithms and remembering that these systems are designed by humans with specific goals, and that their data is a reflection of past realities, not necessarily a prescription for future flourishing.
